title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.

Submit the application before the closing date: 10.09.2026 at 11:59 PM.
Take a printout/screenshot of the submitted application for future reference.
Candidates already in government/semi-government service must submit their application through proper channel along with NOC within 15 days from the last date of application.

howToApply: Download the prescribed application format from CSIR-IHBT website: www.ihbt.res.in
Fill the application form with latest colored passport size photograph affixed on it.
Appear for Walk-in-Interview on the scheduled date, time and venue as mentioned against each position.
Bring self-attested photocopies of testimonials of age, educational qualifications, experience etc.

title: HPRCA Recruitment 2026 – Clerk (Job Trainee) Posts
shortInfo: HPRCA has announced notification for Clerk (Job Trainee) posts. Required qualification: Bachelor's Degree, typing speed 30 wpm English or 25 wpm Hindi. Last date to apply: 11-09-26.
howToApply: Register on the HPRCA portal by clicking the ‘Sign Up’ option to create a username and password.
Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), and uploading photograph, signature, and supporting documents.
Complete/Update your profile on the HPRCA portal (https://hprca.hp.gov.in).
Click on the ‘Apply’ button corresponding to the desired post.
Select your preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu.
Review the auto-filled application details from your profile.
Pay the application fee through the available online payment gateway (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking).
After successful payment, your application will be considered complete. Download and keep a copy of the submitted application form.
